name: codex-marketplace-structure
goal: Accept the documented .agents/plugins marketplace folder without allowing arbitrary hidden folder names

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The official local marketplace uses .agents/plugins/marketplace.json. Harness rejected its documented hidden folder. Expected behavior accepts the exact .agents folder and still rejects arbitrary hidden folders; reproduced in the named structure E2E test.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Red: bunx vitest run test/structure.e2e.test.ts -t Codex-marketplace-equivalent exact named test failed expected audit exit 0, received 1 for .agents/plugins. Failure reproduced before changing src/audit/structureRules.ts.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Added only the exact .agents folder name to existing allowed hidden folders in src/audit/structureRules.ts. Arbitrary hidden-folder rejection remains in the unchanged regression.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: bunx vitest run test/structure.e2e.test.ts passed both tests, including Codex marketplace structure is accepted while unrelated hidden folders are rejected. The same named test originally failed expected audit exit 0, received 1.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: bun run check passed on the completed implementation, including the unchanged structure regression and deterministic root/reports audits. This audit rule has no frontend flow.
